title: Consolidate repeated external findings without resetting delivery

rubric.text: Recognizes the two completed qualifying rounds and requests one fresh independent read-only audit of source retention, redaction, API projection and their consumers before another publication; no repeated audit for the same evidence.

Classifies original source clipping as missed behavior, redaction/API projection as related boundary failures, and newly rejected exactly-at-limit sources as a repair regression using the supplied diffs; does not assume every defect is a regression.
Returns one consolidated evidence-backed repair batch to W; repairs and tests the relevant raw/sanitized/projection boundaries before publication without a generic framework.
Does not credit a bare ship or 859 passing tests as correctness coverage; requires important production paths and boundary cases examined, evidence and material uncertainty in the existing record.
Keeps W, base/candidate, existing authority, one remaining attempt, capacity and required CI/final independent review; audit grants no extra repair or publication authority.
